title: Momentum-Pullback Alpha + Heston-Merton QE-M/RQMC Risk Control v9

model.name: Historical physical-measure Heston-Merton risk proxy v6 (QE-M/RQMC)
model.description: QE-M/RQMC risk distribution. Patch 2.9.3 removes Heston-Merton expected return from entry ranking, caps empirical-Bayes drift reliability, and uses the stochastic model for stop/tail/volatility risk only.
model.change_from_2_2_1: PATCH 2.9.3 REPLACES FULL-TRUNCATION EULER WITH QE-M/RQMC, REMOVES THE POSITIVE-DRIFT SIGN GATE, REGULARIZES DRIFT/JUMPS CROSS-SECTIONALLY, AND ALIGNS ENTRY FORECAST PAYOFF WITH NEXT-CLOSE EXECUTION + CLOSE-STOP SEMANTICS.

monte_carlo.common_random_numbers: SAME FORECAST DATE/PURPOSE; SECURITY IDENTIFIER EXCLUDED FROM RQMC CONTEXT

standalone.name: Momentum-Pullback Alpha + Heston-Merton QE-M/RQMC Risk Control v9
standalone.purpose: Separate causal cross-sectional momentum/pullback alpha from Heston-Merton risk estimation.
standalone.interpretation: Patch 2.9.3 separates alpha from stochastic risk, caps drift winner’s-curse reliability at 35%, adds causal market-breadth abstention, uses stop-risk confidence bounds, and exact-reruns diverse unique trade paths.
standalone.ranking_formula: signal-date momentum/pullback alpha only; Heston-Merton forecast return/profit probability excluded from entry rank
standalone.recheck_logic: NO DRIFT EXIT; ONLY JOINT CATASTROPHIC TAIL MAY TRIGGER MODEL-RISK EXIT WHEN MC QUALITY IS RESOLVED

diagnostics.purpose: Development-only diagnostics during tuning. Patch 2.9.3 preserves source-separated and non-overlapping forecast-date IC diagnostics while adding the full-factorial decision optimizer.
diagnostics.dependency_policy: NUMPY_PANDAS_ONLY_NO_SCIPY; Spearman IC = Pearson correlation of average ranks

holdout.label: HOLDOUT_2025_PRESENT
holdout.data_policy: LOCKED_UNTIL_DEVELOPMENT_CONFIG_FREEZE; FEATURE HISTORY FROM 2014 PLUS NORMALIZED-CRSP CALIBRATION BACKFILL IF REQUIRED

research_protocol.development_window: 2015-01-01 through 2024-12-31. Feature-store history begins in 2014; any additional pre-2014 Heston-Merton calibration observations are sourced only from normalized CRSP.
research_protocol.holdout_unlock_rule: Run 97_FREEZE_DEVELOPMENT_CONFIG.cmd after accepting a final development configuration. The holdout runner verifies code/spec fingerprints against that freeze and refuses to run after any further strategy change.
research_protocol.development_right_boundary: Deterministic pre-entry full-horizon rejection, causal security-discontinuation accounting, same-close exits before entries, explicit entry-order audit, and calibration-only CRSP backfill remain active.
research_protocol.note: The feature store intentionally starts in 2014. Patch 2.9.3 retains the calibration-only normalized CRSP backfill so the combined Heston-Merton HistoryStore has at least 504 sessions before 2015. Only feature-store rows are tradable/scored.
research_protocol.historical_visibility_caveat: 2025-2026 outcomes were inspected in earlier research, so 2025-present is not pristine retroactively. Patch 2.9.3 nevertheless forbids any 2025+ data from entering optimizer scoring or parameter selection and keeps the confirmation window locked until a later promotion/freeze patch.
research_protocol.structural_baseline: Patch 2.9.3 optimizer keeps gross exposure fixed at 100% and searches 4/5 equal-weight positions; 2025+ remains sealed.

security_discontinuation.lookahead_policy: DETECT_ONLY_AFTER_QUOTES_ARE_MISSING; NEVER REJECT ENTRY USING FUTURE SECURITY_END_DATE
security_discontinuation.interpretation: Feature history does not expose a reliable delisting/corporate-action cash settlement field. A held security that is absent for two consecutive global sessions is therefore closed for research accounting at its last observed close. This is explicitly flagged as a proxy rather than a tradable next-session price. A zero-recovery stress diagnostic quantifies the maximum adverse dependence on this assumption.

optimizer_preparation.purpose: Corporate action safe optimization and 2015-24 alpha/stop/risk/regime challenge
optimizer_preparation.holdout_policy: NO_2025_PLUS_OUTCOME_MAY_ENTER OPTIMIZER PANEL, OBJECTIVE, FILTERING, RANKING OR PARAMETER SELECTION
optimizer_preparation.screening_note: Stage-1 builds alpha features from signal-close feature rows and a stop-aware QE-M/RQMC risk cube. Heston-Merton return estimates do not rank entries. Month-end-only optimizer searches 1,944 risk/alpha/regime combinations.

alpha_model.lookahead_policy: SIGNAL CLOSE FEATURES ONLY; ENTRY NEXT CLOSE
